name: Synthetic Creator Campaign Draft Tasks - NO EXTERNAL ACTIONS

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { campaign_id: 'SYN001', client_alias: 'Example Brand', validated: true, approved: false, objective: 'Synthetic lead attribution review' } }];

return $input.all().map(item => { const x=item.json; const valid=typeof x.campaign_id==='string' && /^SYN[0-9]+$/.test(x.campaign_id) && x.validated===true; return {json:{...x, validation_status: valid?'valid':'rejected', execution_allowed:false}}; });

return $input.all().map(item => ({json:{campaign_id:item.json.campaign_id, status:item.json.validation_status==='valid'?'DRAFT_AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL':'REJECTED', next_owner:'Campaign Operations', draft_only:true, note:'No live CRM update or external message has been performed.'}}));
